text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Er stand an der Spitze des Verbands CURAVIVA (Heime und Institutionen Schweiz) und von Curafutura, dem \"Verband der innovativen Krankenversicherer\"", "gist": "Ignazio Cassis was at the head of CURAVIVA and Curafutura"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "2007", "gist": "Year of election to Nationalrat"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "2007 wurde Ignazio Cassis als Vertreter der Tessiner FDP in den Nationalrat gewählt", "gist": "Ignazio Cassis was elected to the National Council in 2007 as a representative of the Ticino FDP"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Ab 2015 war er Präsident der FDP-Liberalen Fraktion der Bundesversammlung", "gist": "From 2015 he was President of the FDP-Liberal parliamentary group"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Ab 2015 hatte er das Präsidium der nationalrätlichen Kommission für soziale Sicherheit und Gesundheit (SGK) inne", "gist": "From 2015 he held the presidency of the National Council's Commission for Social Security and Health (SGK)"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Ignazio Cassis ist verheiratet", "gist": "Ignazio Cassis is married"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Wahl in den Bundesrat", "gist": "Election to the Federal Council"}]}
